AGO.note: The bill is a civil and criminal identification law; it states nothing on the general data protection law's standing, authority or application.

facts.fact: Angola's National Assembly approved in detail on 30 October 2026 chapters III and IV of the Proposta de Lei de Identificacao Civil e Criminal, so the bill is still before parliament.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei de Identificacao Civil e Criminal

AGO.note: The chapters voted cover the criminal record and special registers; nothing on a digital identity.
Criminal-record certificates are identification, not a station record; nothing on stations.
